shortDescription: Science Applications International NASDAQ:SAIC announced Tuesday it has been awarded a $742M recompete task order to provide full-scale support for U.S. Customs and Border Protection, or CBP, systems that are essential to securing our borders and assessing security risk from travelers and cargo ent…

children: announced Tuesday it has been awarded a $742M recompete task order to provide full-scale support for U.S. Customs and Border Protection, or CBP, systems that are essential to securing our borders and assessing security risk from travelers and cargo entering our country.
Shares of SAIC were up 0.60% pre-market.

As the prime contractor, SAIC will provide comprehensive systems support, including software development, operations, maintenance, upgrades, and enhancements. The work will help CBP rapidly respond to evolving technologies, threats, and mission requirements supporting Department of Homeland Security, or DHS, initiatives to strengthen U.S. border security, protect the American people, and support national economic prosperity.
The task order was issued under Alliant 2 and has a period of performance from September 15, 2026, through September 14, 2031.

SAIC also recently won a five-year, $199M recompete task order for the agency’s Integrated Traveler Initiatives, or ITI, 2.1 program. Through ITI 2.1, SAIC will continue supporting technologies that enable secure and efficient processing at ports of entry and inspection checkpoints.

title: SAIC secures U.S. Customs and Border Protection’s $742M recompete contract
